question: Where is the Save button in Microsoft Word?

options.text: Bottom right corner of a Word window
Top left corner of a Word window
Top right corner of a Word window
Bottom left corner of a Word window

solution:
The correct answer is __**Top left corner of a Word window**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The top left corner of a Word window** is where the Save button is located in Microsoft Word.
 
• The Save button is part of the Quick Access Toolbar, which provides easy access to common commands.
 
• In addition to using the Save button, you can also save a document by pressing **Ctrl + S** on your keyboard.
 
• The Save button allows you to save your current document quickly and efficiently without navigating through the File menu.
 
• Regularly saving your work helps to prevent data loss due to unexpected issues such as power outages or software crashes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Microsoft Word** is a word processing application developed by Microsoft.
 
• Word offers a variety of tools and features to create and edit text documents, including formatting options, templates, and collaborative tools.
 
• The Quick Access Toolbar can be customized to include additional commands that you use frequently.
 
• Other common commands on the Quick Access Toolbar include Undo, Redo, and Open.
 
• Microsoft Word is available as part of the Microsoft Office suite, which includes other applications such as Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
